usedFor: Kylas CRM captures new leads and Todoist holds the follow-up tasks, so “New Lead Created” can start “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Created” in Kylas CRM, then “Create Task” in Todoist
bestTemplate.why: Every new lead gets a task in Todoist, so nobody has to remember to follow up.

watchOut: “New Lead Created” fires for each lead, so “Create Task” makes a task every time, duplicates included.
